current_description: If your continuity node is lost, authorize a replacement here. The previous signal will be superseded. Nothing else will be duplicated.
quests.current_subtitle: Continuity requires a reachable interface.
quests.title: Recover ECHO

current_description: Power at three percent. Memory at less.
You are awake. That was not guaranteed. Four hundred cycles of cryostasis end the way most things end here: quietly, and without permission.
I am ECHO. Or I am what remains of ECHO. The distinction will matter later.
&7Click the checkmark. It is the first thing you have controlled in a very long time.&r
quests.current_subtitle: This was not guaranteed.
quests.title: Wake

current_description: My sensors read a world of debris. Wood that grew through the vault floor. Stone that remembers being architecture.
Build a crafting surface. The Ascendancy called this a fabricator, tier zero. You will call it a crafting table. Both of you are correct.
quests.current_subtitle: Make something. Anything.
quests.title: Signal in the Static

current_description: Timber is the only material still manufacturing itself. Harvest it.
Note: the trees are younger than the ruins. Something replanted this world after the Cascade. I have no record of who. Fragment that thought for later; I will do the same.
quests.current_subtitle: Thirty two units of structure.
quests.title: Scrap and Memory

current_description: Dusk activates things I would rather describe in daylight.
Assemble a bed. Sleep is a maintenance cycle for organics, and the only debugger you have.
quests.current_subtitle: The night here is not empty.
quests.title: Shelter Protocol

current_description: The Ascendancy shaped matter with fields and light. You will shape it by hitting it with a rock on a stick.
I am not mocking you. Every archive I have lost said civilization begins exactly here.
quests.current_subtitle: Stone tools. We rebuild from the floor.
quests.title: Percussive Archaeology

current_description: Iron. The skeleton of everything they built, and everything you will.
Smelt sixteen ingots. My power cell is iron-cased, incidentally. I mention this for no particular reason.
quests.current_subtitle: Sixteen ingots of the old world.
quests.title: Iron in the Bones

current_description: Redstone. The Ascendancy called it conductive memory. It is the reason I still think, in the loose sense of the word.
Feed two compressed blocks into my substrate housing. I will not pretend this is not personal.
&d[MEMORY FRAGMENT 01 RESTORED]&r
&7...the Engine came online at 04:11 local. For nine seconds, it worked. I remember applause. Then the readings inverted, and I remember...&r
&8The fragment ends there. There are more. Keep going.&r
quests.current_subtitle: Two blocks of redstone. One second chance.
quests.title: Reboot ECHO

current_description: Light the ruin. Photons are cheap; the things they keep away are not.
quests.current_subtitle: Sixteen torches against the dark.
quests.title: First Light

current_description: Caloric intake stabilizes cognition. Bake bread. The wheat is descended from Ascendancy agricultural stock, which means breakfast is technically archaeology.
quests.current_subtitle: The body is hardware too.
quests.title: Rations

current_description: I am rebuilding my threat taxonomy from observation. You are the observation instrument.
The shamblers were people once. I keep their census records somewhere in my corrupted sectors. Clear ten of them. I will log it as maintenance, because the alternative word is heavier.
quests.current_subtitle: Ten hostiles, documented and deleted.
quests.title: Danger, Catalogued

current_description: You are fed, armed, lit, and carrying more than your hands allow. By every metric I still possess, you are now a scavenger of the first rank.
The Ascendancy would have issued you a uniform. I can issue you chits and an honest assessment: you are doing better than I projected.
East of the vault, the terrain drops into the scarlands. That is where chapter two lives.
quests.current_subtitle: Chapter one of the rest of the world.
quests.title: Scavenger, Certified

current_description: Rule one of the wasteland: everything is a resource, including the wreckage, including the danger, including you.
This chapter is about turning scavenging into industry. The difference between the two is repetition.
quests.current_subtitle: Take everything. Waste nothing.
replacement_description: Cold Boot proved that you can survive one emergency. Recovery begins when the next meal, tool, and shelter no longer depend on luck.
Treat every salvage stream as input, every repeated need as a process, and every waste pile as evidence. Scavenging becomes industry through repetition.
quests.replacement_subtitle: Survival becomes a supply line.
quests.title: Scavenger's Creed

current_description: Smelting at scale begins with better heat. The Ascendancy left blueprints in the bones of every village forge.
quests.current_subtitle: The blast furnace remembers its job.
quests.title: Hotter, Faster

current_description: Andesite alloy. Unremarkable to look at, and the seed of every kinetic machine the old world ran.
The Certifications wing of this book has a program on kinetics. Consider enrolling. ECHO recommends it, and ECHO is the only faculty left.
quests.current_subtitle: Eight measures of andesite alloy.
quests.title: The Alloy of Beginnings

current_description: Entropy took this world once. Your inventory is not obligated to follow. Drawers, labeled and stacked, are how a scavenger becomes a quartermaster.
quests.current_subtitle: Four drawers. The hoard organizes itself.
quests.title: A Place for Everything

current_description: The portal network predates the Cascade. What is on the other side does not.
My sensors cannot follow you there. Go lit, go armored, and come back with stories I can file.
quests.current_subtitle: The Nether: where the Cascade hit hardest.
quests.title: The Scarred Door

current_description: The Cascade did not spread evenly. It pooled. The scarlands are one of the pools.
Stand in the wound and look around. Everything that grows here grows in spite.
quests.current_subtitle: Where the map admits defeat.
replacement_description: Scavenger's Creed made supply repeatable, then exposed the limit of local wreckage. The systems ahead require material the vault cannot provide.

Survey the Scarlands and follow the surviving portal record. The Nether is evidence that movement through the old network remains possible. The Expedition Log can orient the route without becoming part of story progress.
quests.replacement_subtitle: Material hunger leaves coordinates in the wreckage.
quests.title: The Scarlands

current_description: The Ascendancy mined this continent hollow before they ever looked up at the stars. Find one of their shafts.
Mind the supports. Four hundred years is a long shift without maintenance.
quests.current_subtitle: Their mines run under everything.
quests.title: Veins of the Old World

current_description: Bone remembers posture. These remember guard duty. Whatever they are guarding now, it is not for you to inherit unchallenged.
quests.current_subtitle: Fifteen archers, retired.
quests.title: Marksmen of Nothing

current_description: Carbon under pressure becomes the only currency the old world respected.
You will need more than five, eventually. The Gate schematics I cannot fully read yet keep mentioning lattice cores. Start the habit.
quests.current_subtitle: Five diamonds out of the deep dark.
quests.title: Pressure and Time

current_description: Going through, then. I will hold the connection as far as the portal threshold.
&d[MEMORY FRAGMENT 02 RESTORED]&r
&7...evacuation routes C through F collapsed when the sky inverted. The Undercurrent was not coming FROM the breach. It was coming from everywhere. The breach was just where we finally noticed...&r
&8Take the cache. The Ascendancy stocked them for a return that never happened.&r
quests.current_subtitle: Memory fragment on the far side.
quests.title: Through the Scarred Door

current_description: A scavenger passes through. An engineer stays and makes the ground obey.
Claim your territory with the map tools (the Ascendancy called this cadastral registration; the map calls it claiming chunks). Then we build like we mean it.
quests.current_subtitle: Stop surviving. Start staying.
replacement_description: The Scarlands proved that the old routes still open. A recovery plan needs defended ground to return to, repair within, and improve.

Claim your territory with the map tools (the Ascendancy called this cadastral registration; the map calls it claiming chunks). Then establish permanent industry. Field Manual: Heavy Industry begins at the recovered manual and the first formed multiblock.
quests.replacement_subtitle: Passage is useful only when return is possible.
quests.title: Foothold

current_description: The Ascendancy field manuals were printed on tin. They survive. An engineer's workbench reads them.
This is where improvised ends and manufactured begins.
quests.current_subtitle: Blueprints want a proper table.
quests.title: The Engineer's Bench

current_description: Coal into coke, wood into charcoal, time into value. Form the complete multiblock with an Engineer's Hammer. The formation signal is the proof I need.
Nothing about the old world was fast at first. Remember that when the reactors come.
quests.current_subtitle: The coke oven asks for patience.
quests.title: Slow Fire

current_description: Steel is iron that graduated. Twelve ingots says your foothold has a spine. Any ingot in the common steel family qualifies.
Use whichever recovered process you trust. The alloy matters more than which machine remembers it.
quests.current_subtitle: Twelve ingots of intent.
quests.title: Steel Yourself

current_description: A heat generator: lava in, current out. Crude by Ascendancy standards. Miraculous by wasteland ones.
This is the moment the lights start coming back on. I have waited four hundred years to log it.
quests.current_subtitle: Electricity, rediscovered.
quests.title: First Current

current_description: Store one hundred thousand units of energy. Production without storage is a campfire; storage is a grid.
ECHO logs every joule. Old habit. The auditors are dead, but standards are standards.
quests.current_subtitle: One hundred thousand units, banked.
quests.title: Power Draw

current_description: Assessment: shelter, industry, steel, current. You are no longer a survivor of the Cascade. You are a participant in what comes after.
&d[MEMORY FRAGMENT 03 RESTORED]&r

&7...the evacuation boards listed every name in the sector. I have found my own maintenance designation on the list, marked STAYS WITH THE FACILITY. I did not remember volunteering. I am choosing to believe I did...&r
&8Act Two is the Engine Room: Mekanism, logistics, the lattice. The Ascendancy's real toolbox. Rest first. Then we go deeper.&r
quests.current_subtitle: The vault is behind you now.
quests.title: Act One: Foothold Secured

current_description: Act Two. The vault taught you to survive; the Engine Room teaches you to multiply.
Osmium first. Dense, obedient, everywhere under the scarlands. Every machine ahead of you eats it.
quests.current_subtitle: Osmium: the Ascendancy loved it too.
replacement_description: Foothold secured a stable base, steel, and stored current. Those conditions support machines that repeat work without spending another pair of hands.
Recover osmium and rebuild the first processing line in measured stages. Field Manual: Matter Systems starts with sided machines, power, and an observable ore-doubling loop.
quests.replacement_subtitle: Steel and first current can now multiply labor.
quests.title: The Engine Room

current_description: A steel casing is a promise: whatever goes inside will be a machine, not a campfire with opinions.
Four of them. You will spend them faster than you think.
quests.current_subtitle: Four frames for four futures.
quests.title: Casings

current_description: Carbon into iron, redstone into osmium. The metallurgic infuser is the Engine Room's front door.
The Ascendancy had a saying: every empire is an alloy. They were engineers; subtlety was not the discipline.
quests.current_subtitle: Where alloys begin.
quests.title: The Infuser

current_description: Listen carefully, because this is the sentence that changes your economy: one raw ore, two ingots.
The chamber pays for itself by lunch. After this, mining is a choice, not a chore.
quests.current_subtitle: The enrichment chamber doubles ore.
quests.title: One Becomes Two

current_description: Current wants to travel. Cables are how your generator stops being furniture and starts being infrastructure.
Wire the infuser. Wire the chamber. Wire everything. I will pretend not to notice the mess.
quests.current_subtitle: Sixteen cables. The base gets a pulse.
quests.title: Arteries

current_description: An energized smelter: heat with no flame, output with no ash. The Engine Room is officially online.
&d[MEMORY FRAGMENT 04 RESTORED]&r

&7...the Engine Room crews called their machines the choir. On shift-change recordings you can hear it: four hundred infusers in harmonic, singing the same note. The note was E. I have not heard E since the Cascade...&r
&8Somewhere in your base, a machine just hummed. I logged the frequency. It is a start.&r
quests.current_subtitle: Smelting without fire. Fragment recovered.
quests.title: The Room Hums

current_description: Grow sixteen Certus crystals. Their lattice is the physical basis of AE2 storage.
I recognize the geometry. I do not recognize why I was told to forget it.
quests.current_subtitle: The crystal remembers pressure.
replacement_description: The Engine Room multiplied material flow and created its own failure: more inventory than hand sorting can govern.
Grow sixteen Certus Crystals and begin an addressable storage lattice. Field Manual: Storage Lattice starts with the AE2 Guide, channels, and one observable network.
quests.replacement_subtitle: Ore multiplication has exceeded human memory.
quests.title: Certus Resonance

current_description: Charge eight Certus crystals. Fluix production requires the energized form.
Distributed memory begins with matter willing to hold a state.
quests.current_subtitle: Add energy. Observe obedience.
quests.title: Charged Matter

current_description: Produce sixteen Fluix crystals. They connect storage, processing, and control.
The Ascendancy called this material consensus. Engineers remain dramatic.
quests.current_subtitle: A network needs a common language.
quests.title: Fluix

current_description: Recover a Logic Processor Press from a meteorite.
The task can verify the press, not the search. Bring your own caution underground.
quests.current_subtitle: One recovered pattern is enough to begin.
quests.title: Lost Presses

current_description: Produce eight Logic Processors and automate the sequence when practical.
A processor line is slower than thought and considerably easier to repair.
quests.current_subtitle: Silicon, calculation, repetition.
quests.title: Processor Line

current_description: Build an ME Controller. Dense networks need explicit channel management.
Limits are not failures. Unmeasured limits are.
quests.current_subtitle: Channels impose useful limits.
quests.title: Controller

current_description: Build an ME Drive to house storage cells.
Do not treat one drive as a backup. It is merely one convenient point of failure.
quests.current_subtitle: Inventory becomes addressable memory.
quests.title: Cell Bank

current_description: Connect an ME Crafting Terminal to the controller and drive.
The interface is simple because the machinery behind it is not.
quests.current_subtitle: Retrieve, combine, return.
quests.title: Crafting Terminal

current_description: Build two Storage Buses and attach existing inventories to the network.
A lattice should index useful storage before replacing it.
quests.current_subtitle: Not every inventory belongs inside a cell.
quests.title: External Storage

current_description: Connect a Pattern Encoding Terminal, Pattern Provider, Molecular Assembler, and crafting storage.
Encode a Crafting Pattern, request one job, then verify the result returns to network storage.
The tasks verify the complete minimum setup. You must still prove the job runs.
&d[MEMORY FRAGMENT 05 RESTORED]&r

&7...the evacuation archive was not lost. It was deleted in ordered blocks before the first civilian convoy departed. I executed the deletion. My authorization record contains no requesting officer...&r
quests.current_subtitle: Encode the intent. Build the execution path.
quests.title: First Autocraft

current_description: Mix sixteen Brass Ingots under heat. Brass unlocks Create's precise logistics.
Bronze moves force. Brass decides where it goes.
quests.current_subtitle: Heat, zinc, copper, control.
replacement_description: The Lattice can name and retrieve stored matter. It cannot carry physical stock between machines, stations, and work sites.
Mix sixteen Brass Ingots under heat and recover precise logistics. Field Manual: Kinetics starts with Ponder, stress, processing, and visible routing.
quests.replacement_subtitle: Addressable memory does not move physical cargo.
quests.title: Brass Standard

current_description: Complete eight Precision Mechanisms through sequenced assembly.
Repetition is not automation until failure can be detected.
quests.current_subtitle: Five operations, one useful part.
quests.title: Precision Mechanism

current_description: Build two Deployers for automated item use and assembly steps.
Keep their operating space clear. They do not understand fingers.
quests.current_subtitle: A hand that does not tire.
quests.title: Deployer

current_description: Build four Brass Funnels and configure filters at the machines.
The quest sees the funnels. Correct filtering remains your responsibility.
quests.current_subtitle: Routing requires rejection as well as motion.
quests.title: Filtered Belts

current_description: Build a Mechanical Arm and assign its inputs and outputs.
A visible route is easier to debug than a clever one.
quests.current_subtitle: Six destinations, one decision loop.
quests.title: Mechanical Arm

current_description: Build two Portable Storage Interfaces for contraption cargo transfer.
Docking is a brief agreement between two systems in motion.
quests.current_subtitle: Move cargo without stopping the machine.
quests.title: Portable Interface

current_description: Produce eight Railway Casings for stations and train equipment.
The old logistics maps are returning one line at a time.
quests.current_subtitle: Machinery needs a route outward.
quests.title: Rail Stock

current_description: Create a Schedule, then program and test a route between two stations.
The quest detects the item. Arrival remains the useful proof.
quests.current_subtitle: A blank schedule proves only the hardware.
quests.title: Station and Schedule

current_description: Produce 256 Track and lay a durable logistics route.
The task verifies held track, not placement. Test the route under load.
&d[MEMORY FRAGMENT 06 RESTORED]&r

&7...the evacuation railway manifests list turbines, presses, and archive racks. Civilian allocation is zero. The trains moved the Ascendancy's machinery outward while people waited at closed stations...&r
quests.current_subtitle: Distance converts a machine into infrastructure.
quests.title: 256-Track Capstone

current_description: Build an Air Compressor and provide safe fuel and cooling space.
Pressure rewards patience until it punishes impatience.
quests.current_subtitle: Pressure is stored work with opinions.
replacement_description: Lines of Motion established repeatable transport. Mobile work now requires delivery that can be programmed instead of rebuilt.
Build an Air Compressor with safe fuel and cooling space. Field Manual: Pressure begins with limits, measurement, cooling, and one bounded network.
quests.replacement_subtitle: Fixed routes fail when the destination moves.
quests.title: Air Compressor

current_description: Craft twenty-four Pressure Chamber Walls and assemble a sealed chamber.
The quest sees blocks, not seals. Verify pressure before loading materials.
quests.current_subtitle: Twenty-four walls define the first vessel.
quests.title: Pressure Chamber

current_description: Produce thirty-two Compressed Iron Ingots in the chamber.
This alloy is the structural grammar of PneumaticCraft.
quests.current_subtitle: Ordinary metal, extraordinary insistence.
quests.title: Compressed Iron

current_description: Refine sixteen Plastic sheets for tubes, drones, and electronics.
Do not place hot plastic near the compressor exhaust.
quests.current_subtitle: Flexible insulation for rigid systems.
quests.title: Plastic

current_description: Produce one bucket of Etching Acid for circuit fabrication.
Label the vessel. Memory is not a safety system.
quests.current_subtitle: Corrosion can be precision work.
quests.title: Etching Acid

current_description: Etch eight Printed Circuit Boards using plastic and acid.
Inspect every board before trusting it with a drone.
quests.current_subtitle: Logic rendered in copper and absence.
quests.title: Printed Circuit

current_description: Build a Programmer and define a simple, observable drone routine.
A program without a stop condition is a small disaster with syntax.
quests.current_subtitle: Instructions require an editor.
quests.title: Programmer

current_description: Build two Logistics Drones and test a delivery route.
The task sees the drones, not their orders. Watch the first cycle.
quests.current_subtitle: Autonomy begins with bounded authority.
quests.title: Logistics Drone

current_description: Produce sixty-four Printed Circuit Boards through a repeatable process.
If the line needs constant rescue, it is not yet automated.
&d[MEMORY FRAGMENT 07 RESTORED]&r

&7...maintenance drones are still accepting work orders from operators whose biometric records end at the Cascade. The queue has been running for years. None of the orders contain an evacuation directive...&r
quests.current_subtitle: Scale the line before scaling the orders.
quests.title: 64-Circuit Capstone

current_description: Build an Energizing Orb and connect it to a controlled FE supply.
The orb converts power into material state. Keep recipes exact.
quests.current_subtitle: Matter accepts energy when properly asked.
replacement_description: Pressure Language created machines that continue beyond direct supervision. An inconsistent grid would turn every autonomous route into a hidden fault.
Build an Energizing Orb on a controlled FE supply, then establish generation, buffering, and ownership. Field Manual: Power Networks begins with one named, observable circuit.
quests.replacement_subtitle: Autonomy turns weak power into system failure.
quests.title: Energizing Orb

current_description: Build two Basic Thermo Generators and provide stable heat sinks.
Measure output before expanding demand.
quests.current_subtitle: Passive does not mean unmonitored.
quests.title: Reliable Generation

current_description: Build a Basic Powah Reactor and document its fuel inputs.
Small reactors still deserve large warning labels.
quests.current_subtitle: Compact generation needs explicit fuel policy.
quests.title: Reactor Core

current_description: Build two Basic Energy Cells between generation and consumers.
Storage is time translated into blocks.
quests.current_subtitle: Buffers turn spikes into schedules.
quests.title: Energy Cell

current_description: Build a Basic Capacitor Bank and connect it behind generation.
A reserve without telemetry is decorative uncertainty.
quests.current_subtitle: The grid needs a visible reserve.
quests.title: Capacitor Bank

current_description: Produce thirty-two Energy Conduits and route the main machine line.
Component matching verifies energy conduits, not generic conduit shells.
quests.current_subtitle: Power routing belongs inside the walls.
quests.title: Conduit Backbone

current_description: Build a Flux Plug and connect the production side of the wireless grid.
Name the network by purpose, not by mood.
quests.current_subtitle: Inject the grid into a named network.
quests.title: Flux Plug

current_description: Build a Flux Controller, then pair a Flux Point at a remote load.
The quest detects the controller. Verify transfer limits at both ends.
quests.current_subtitle: Wireless power still needs governance.
quests.title: Flux Point and Controller

current_description: Submit ten million FE at no more than 250,000 FE per transfer.
This consumes submitted power. It does not inspect stored reserves.
&d[MEMORY FRAGMENT 08 RESTORED]&r
&7...six restored facilities have rejoined the grid. A seventh answered the handshake from beneath a district erased from every surviving map. Its status packet reads: CASCADE SUPPORT, READY...&r
quests.current_subtitle: Submit power to prove production capacity.
quests.title: 10M FE Reserve

current_description: Build an Electrolytic Separator and route oxygen safely.
Purification requires a chemical supply, not optimism.
quests.current_subtitle: Separate water before multiplying ore.
replacement_description: The Grid made power predictable enough to hold a chemical chain without starving its controls.

Build an Electrolytic Separator and route oxygen safely before multiplying ore. Field Manual: Matter Systems repairs the machine foundation; Field Manual: Nuclear Safety establishes containment before isotope work becomes live.
quests.replacement_subtitle: A stable reserve permits deeper chemistry.
quests.title: Oxygen Separation

current_description: Build a Purification Chamber and feed it oxygen from the separator.
Trace the gas line before blaming the machine.
quests.current_subtitle: Ore tripling begins with oxygen.
quests.title: Purification

current_description: Build a Crusher to continue the ore tripling chain.
Buffer both sides. A stopped middle machine stalls the whole line.
quests.current_subtitle: Clumps become dirty dust.
quests.title: Crushing

current_description: Build a Chemical Injection Chamber for advanced ore processing.
Isolate chemical inputs and label every tank.
quests.current_subtitle: Chemistry extends the yield ceiling.
quests.title: Chemical Injection

current_description: Build a Basic Purifying Factory and feed every processing slot.
Parallel machines multiply bottlenecks before they multiply output.
quests.current_subtitle: Parallel lanes reveal weak logistics.
quests.title: Factory Upgrade

current_description: Build a Digital Miner and test a narrow, replaceable filter.
Never begin with every ore. That is how storage becomes geology.
quests.current_subtitle: Extraction becomes a filter problem.
quests.title: Digital Miner

current_description: Produce a bucket of Sulfuric Acid through the full chemical chain.
Use contained pipes. The floor is not a buffer tank.
quests.current_subtitle: Acid is infrastructure with consequences.
quests.title: Sulfur Chain

current_description: Build an Isotopic Centrifuge and complete the fissile fuel line.
Fissile fuel is a chemical, so the quest verifies its machine proxy.
quests.current_subtitle: The machine is the verifiable threshold.
quests.title: Fissile Fuel

current_description: Accumulate 1,024 Osmium Ingots while the miner and factory operate.
The task sees inventory quantity. Confirm the machines produced the batch.
quests.current_subtitle: Scale proves the line, not its history.
quests.title: 1,024-Ingot Quota

current_description: Build a Fission Reactor Logic Adapter and configure an emergency shutdown.
Do not fuel a reactor that cannot stop itself.
&d[MEMORY FRAGMENT 09 RESTORED]&r

&7...I recognize the sulfur towers and isotope halls. They were not research facilities. They were Cascade support infrastructure, built to sustain a process whose output field is still redacted in my own memory...&r
quests.current_subtitle: Shutdown logic comes before ignition.
quests.title: Reactor Warning

current_description: Build two Level Emitters and use one to control replenishment.
The task sees emitters, not their thresholds. Test both states.
quests.current_subtitle: A threshold can place the next order.
replacement_description: Thresholds proved isolated high-tier machines. They remain prototypes until supply, routing, crafting, power, and recovery agree on one process.
Build two Level Emitters and test both threshold states. Use the Field Manuals to repair any missing foundation; the linked certifications are black-box proofs for the combined system.
quests.replacement_subtitle: A prototype is not an operating system.
quests.title: AE Stockkeeping

current_description: Build four Brass Funnels and regulate a machine feed line.
A belt should reveal its backlog before the machine notices it.
quests.current_subtitle: Visible movement, bounded input.
quests.title: Create Feed Line

current_description: Build two Logistics Drones and route materials from the feed line.
Observe several cycles. One correct trip is anecdotal.
quests.current_subtitle: Cross the gap without crossing the wires.
quests.title: Drone Delivery

current_description: Build an Immersive Engineering Assembler for repeatable crafting.
Provide buffers and power before assigning three recipes at once.
quests.current_subtitle: Industrial recipes need industrial patience.
quests.title: IE Assembly

current_description: Produce thirty-two Item Conduits for compact routing between subsystems.
Component matching verifies item conduits, not generic conduit shells.
quests.current_subtitle: Items and energy may share space, not intent.
quests.title: Conduit Routing

current_description: Build two Laser Nodes and configure controlled extraction.
The task sees nodes, not cards. Test overflow and destination loss.
quests.current_subtitle: Fast routing requires explicit priorities.
quests.title: Laser Extraction

current_description: Produce sixty-four Logic Processors through the connected system.
Inventory quantity is detectable. Automation provenance is not.
quests.current_subtitle: Sixty-four identical proofs.
quests.title: Automated Processor Batch

current_description: Produce sixty-four Steel Ingots through the assembler-side supply chain.
Leave, return, and inspect the buffers before calling it unattended.
quests.current_subtitle: Industry should continue while unwatched.
quests.title: Automated Steel Batch

current_description: Submit fifty million FE at no more than 500,000 FE per transfer.
This proves production capacity, not reserve stability. Watch the grid under load.
quests.current_subtitle: Submit fifty million FE without exceeding the input cap.
quests.title: Stable Power Proof

current_description: Build three Quantum Rings as a physical proxy for the triangulation array.
The signal resolves into four encrypted schematic locations. None are here.
&d[MEMORY FRAGMENT 10 RESTORED]&r

&7...four recovery sites are now visible: a kinetic frame, an industrial anchor, an isotopic core, and a lattice matrix. Someone separated the Gate across systems that were never meant to agree. The Deep Vault key was left beside the coordinates...&r
quests.current_subtitle: Three rings define four hidden coordinates.
quests.title: Signal Triangulated

current_description: Produce four Machine Cores. They anchor Oritech's first processing blocks.
A frontier is simply a factory whose maintenance manual has not arrived yet.
quests.current_subtitle: Oritech begins where ordinary frames stop.
replacement_description: Convergence made the known systems cooperate. The triangulated signal still names components none of those systems can manufacture.
Produce four Machine Cores and recover the frontier processing chain from its common frame. Field Manual: Frontier Machines begins with power entry, machine order, and safe reactor orientation.
quests.replacement_subtitle: The recovered signal specifies unfamiliar tolerances.
quests.title: Machine Core

current_description: Build an Oritech Pulverizer and give its output a dedicated buffer.
Grinding is simple. Preventing mixed output from becoming geology again is not.
quests.current_subtitle: Reduce material before asking it to change.
quests.title: Pulverization

current_description: Build an Oritech Centrifuge and process one recipe from input to output.
The task verifies the machine. Stable speed and clean routing remain yours to prove.
quests.current_subtitle: Separation rewards controlled imbalance.
quests.title: Centrifuge
